title: Iloilo International Airport back to normal ops after emergency repairs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Iloilo International Airport resumed normal operations on Wednesday following emergency repairs on its runway, the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) said on Wednesday. In a statement, Caap said the airport completed emergency repairs on a portion of its runway on Nov. 24, after pavement damage temporarily suspended several arriving and departing flights.
